component.name: Spot-Free
component.summary: Safe Spotify playlist and track downloader with zip options

description.p: Spot-Free is a fast, native desktop application for Linux that allows you to safely connect to your Spotify account and download your playlists or individual tracks.

ul.li: Safe Spotify integration using official OAuth 2.0 PKCE without exposing your account password or risking bans.
Download full user playlists, your entire Liked Songs library, or individual songs.
Flexible ZIP packaging: save as direct audio files, separate ZIP archives per playlist, or one consolidated archive.
Automatic metadata tagging with album artwork and optional M3U playlist file generation.
High quality audio formats: MP3 (up to 320kbps), FLAC, M4A, and OPUS.
Built for Linux Flatpak with modern native performance.

description.p: Version 0.5.1 Beta release with full public playlist library pagination (all older and newer public playlists), Title Case Spot-Free branding, and updated standalone executable.
